prompts: The helper tests pass but the actual scheduling entrypoint fails to queue requests. Reproduce through framework.evaluate_tick and fix the callback contract. Keep the disabled skip behavior and both request keys. The included framework represents the pinned public contract.

files.README.md: The public framework entrypoint evaluate_tick calls the callback. A callback returns one Request/Skip or yields individual Request objects; a returned list is one invalid nested item. tick must queue north-daily and south-daily when enabled, and skip with reason disabled otherwise. Keep the pinned framework's public semantics for other callbacks; update tests to use the same seam the scheduler uses.
